title: Polar grid: sector resistor driven across the angle (analytic)
description:
Electric currents in an annular sector a < r < b, angle_start < phi < angle_start + Phi, on a polar (r, phi) domain (coordinates 'polar', radius_min = a, angle_min = angle_start, size_y = Phi). The two rays are the electrodes: y_lo (phi = angle_start) held at V0, y_hi at 0 V; the arcs x_lo / x_hi are insulated, so the current runs around the angle (the angular faces and the r_c dphi distances of the metric, not the radial ones of polar_annulus_log_profile). Uniform sigma_dc on 'all'.
Analytic: V = V0 (1 - (phi - angle_start) / Phi), angular current density J_phi = sigma V0 / (r Phi), conductance per metre of depth G' = sigma ln(b / a) / Phi, Joule power P' = V0^2 G'.
Derived values tab: G_per_m (drive current / voltage), I_ground (the scalar output current_ground = -G' V0), P_joule (integral of q_joule over the sector areas = V0 I exactly), V_probe (probe at a cell-centre angle: V is exactly linear in phi on the cells). Expect G and P ~1.4e-5 below the analytic value (the radial rows add up as the midpoint rule of the integral of dr / r), V_probe to the CG accuracy.
Line profile tab: V_chord (a straight chord across the angle near the outer arc: the angle staircase of the containing-cell image, ~0.3 %) and J_angular (J_y = the angular component along the ray at mid-angle: 1 / r, ~1 % from the radial cell image).
Sweep tab: G_per_m versus the sector angle Phi (pi/6, pi/3, pi/2; G' ~ 1 / Phi) with the dashed G_vs_angle.

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: voltage of the y_lo ray [V]; the y_hi ray is held at 0 V

parameters.name: angle_start
parameters.description: angle of the y_lo ray in rad (angle_min)

parameters.name: sector_angle
parameters.description: sector angle Phi in rad (size_y; swept)

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: radial cell size, also the cell length along the outer arc

parameters.name: n_angle
parameters.description: angle cells of the mesh (Phi b / dx rounded up, as the polar mesher does)

parameters.name: phi_probe
parameters.description: probe angle: a cell-centre angle about a third of the way across

parameters.name: G_ref
parameters.description: analytic conductance per metre of depth in S/m

parameters.name: r_chord
parameters.description: radius of the chord end points

parameters.name: phi_mid
parameters.description: mid-angle of the sector (ray of J_angular)
